name: io.github.mishingo/renewalmath
title: RenewalMath: verified small-business software prices
description: Verified list prices for 144 small-business software tools: compare plans, audit a stack.

tools.name: list_tracked_tools
tools.description: List every software tool with verified current prices, grouped by category, with plan names. Call this first to learn the tool and plan names the other tools accept.

category.description: Optional category filter. Call without it to see the categories.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current verified list prices for one tool: every plan, what it costs per month and per year at a given team size, the yearly-billed price where published, confirmed price changes, and archived prices from earlier years with their sources.

tool.description: Tool name or id, for example "Gusto" or "quickbooks-online"

seats.description: People on payroll or user seats. Ignored for flat-priced plans. Default 1.

tools.name: compare_costs
tools.description: Rank plans by monthly cost at a given team size, cheapest first: every tracked plan in a category ("cheapest payroll software for 12 employees"), or the plans of specific tools ("Gusto vs QuickBooks Payroll for 12 people"). Give category or tools.

category.description: A category from list_tracked_tools, for example payroll, accounting or ai

tools.description: Two or more tool names or ids to compare head to head

seats.description: People on payroll or user seats. Default 1.

tools.name: audit_stack
tools.description: Given the tools and plans a business pays for, return the yearly total, how much it could save (by switching to a similar cheaper plan or by paying yearly, whichever saves more for each tool), which tools had a confirmed price increase in the last 12 months, and the cheapest similar plan from another provider for each.

plan.description: Plan name or id. If omitted, the entry plan is assumed.

seats.description: People on payroll or user seats for this tool. Default 1.

tools.name: recent_price_changes
tools.description: Price changes we have confirmed on the vendor's own page since tracking began, newest first. Optionally for one tool.
